entry_points.summary: Schema v1 registry with 14 stable invariant entries (inv_001, inv_002, inv_003, inv_004, inv_005, inv_006, inv_007, inv_008, inv_009, inv_010, inv_011, inv_012, inv_013, inv_014).

invariants: INVARIANTS.json is user-authored and optional; absence is normal and consumers fall back gracefully.
IDs are stable inv_NNN values and must not be reused.
Writes to the registry must be atomic.
Tags must remain within the controlled docs/memory tag set.
Optional sighting fields may be absent until a review run observes a match.
gotchas: Do not auto-generate invariants from vague prose.
Entry source_files inside the registry can drift independently from the invariant behavior.
Some old source paths in entry metadata may need future cleanup while the behavior remains valid.
